Send.It Send.it allows you to easily share your media over a local network instead of the internet. This app requires a Wi-Fi connection to work. Both devices must be connected to the same Wi-Fi network and have Send.it installed. When should you use Send.it? Use Send.it to send media files to a nearby Android device (and soon to desktop, too!). For example, if you\'ve captured high-quality videos that are too large to share easily, and you want to send them to someone nearby, you can use Send.it to share this data without losing quality. Since this process doesn’t require an internet connection, your data stays private, with no third-party servers involved—keeping all your privacy in your control. Welcome to Send.It Before starting Send.it, there are a few things that need to be set up. Please provide the necessary details to get the best experience with Send.it. Send.it allows you to easily share media with nearby devices, so it requires permission to access your media, enabling you to select the content you want to share. Send.it is designed to keep your data private; it does not share any information with third-party servers and only transfers data over the local network. An active internet connection is not required for Send.it to work—both devices just need to be connected to the same Wi-Fi network, whether or not that network has internet access. Android 14 introduces Selected Photos and Videos Access, allowing you to grant Send.it access to specific images and videos on your device, rather than giving access to all media files of a certain type. This new feature is part of Android\'s ongoing efforts to enhance user privacy. It also affects how Send.it accesses your media. Since Send.it doesn\’t connect to any third-party server, your media isn\’t shared over the internet. You can choose to allow access to all media or select specific items, and you can add more photos or videos next time as needed. If the other device doesn\’t have Send.it installed, share the installation link with them by clicking the button below. Share This App Hello I\'m using Send.It to sharing my photos and videos with nearby devices, it\'s easy and quick. You can also try this, click on the link below to download it from the play store.
